name: rules-rtdb-r19-literal-and-wildcard-siblings
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r19-literal-and-wildcard-siblings" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). the simulator decides which sibling rules apply to a literal key; a wrong choice grants reads or writes that production denies, or denies writes production allows.
